title: Reading an OpenAPI spec and exploring it in Swagger UI

objectives.text: Read an OpenAPI document to find an operation's path, parameters, request body schema and response codes
Add the springdoc-openapi library to a Boot project and open the generated OpenAPI document and Swagger UI locally
Send a request from Swagger UI and compare its documented and actual responses

This worst path was modeled, not measured on these pages. budget = aboutLabel = ceil(max(P50, worst path)) under the new-course rule in authoring/docs/tools/validators.md, within the 15 minute cap.
